title: Hi-Light R9 titanium road disc frame
notes: Exact R9 frameset page lists a titanium frame and carbon fork, hydroformed shaped and butted tubes, CNC-integrated 3Al–2.5V titanium dropouts, CNC head tube, 3D-integrated BB shell, press-fit BB86.5, internal routing, mechanical/electronic compatibility, flat mount, 27.2 mm seatpost, 100×12 / 142×12 thru-axles, 700×28C maximum, 1,730 g manufacturer frame claim and XS–XL plus custom sizing. The published titanium grade applies specifically to the dropouts; the main-tube grade is not stated.
